full_judgment: 2. The respondent herein filed Writ Petition No. 5882 of 2000 before the High Court Division challenging memo No.Boi Mu Ni (Aba) 144/235/2000/2461 dated 21.08.2000, issued under the signature of Deputy Director, Foreign Currency Department, Bangladesh Bank, (writ-respondent No. 3) cancelling the writ petitioner's "Money Changer License" No.Boi Mu. Ni (Aba) 144/97-1730 dated 17.09.1997 (Annexure-F to the writ petition). It is stated in the writ petition that the writ petitioner, as the proprietor of "M/S. Turna Moneychanger", was granted with the above noted "Money Changer Licence" on 17.09.97 under the provision of section 3 of the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947 by the writ respondent(appellant herein). Since then he had been carrying on the said business as per directives and instructions of the Bangladesh Bank embodied in the Foreign Exchange Circular No. 2 dated 14.01.2000. The Bangladesh Bank through its inspection team regularly inspected the business at intervals. The Deputy General Manager A.K.M. Motafizur Rahman of Bangladesh Bank by his letter dated 30.07.2000 alleged that the Inspection Team of the Bangladesh Bank found that the writ petitioner has committed certain acts in violation of the directives and instructions issued by the Bangladesh Bank from time to time and as such asked the writ petitioner to show cause, within 7 days, why his "money changer licence" should not be cancelled or revoked for:
